notes.content: [h1]Today is my birthday![/h1][p][/p][h3]And with that, a mid-sized update is in order~[/h3][p]The main focus of this update was quality-of-life improvements, for both sides. Since there are many visible and behind-the-scenes changes, I’ll highlight the most important categories:[/p][list][*][p][b]Technical Backend[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimization[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Linux Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Always available Manual[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Labyrinth Paths Help[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]And many, many more hidden stuff.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Also made a small teaser, for some... purposes:[/h3][previewyoutube="BLRle58C1wQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Changes:[/h1][list][*][p]New Dialogue/Monologue animated formatting.[/p][/*][*][p](Nerf) Different Anxiety defence requirement. \[It's easier to understand now...?][/p][/*][*][p]Rectified Disclaimer when it comes to bug awareness, recording requests and possible contact. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated to Unity 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Launcher without Engine logo.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixes:[/h1][list][*][p] Dialogue/Monologue text generation speed is now stable on all refresh rates. [/p][/*][/list]

[list]
[*] Changed Save Cloud path and .exe name in order to avoid special characters.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The game is now half the storage size[/b], cause previously Steam Depot placed an additional copy of the game build inside the game file itself. :/
[/list]

[previewyoutube=jZ9JGN82fjA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Scene prototype[/b] [Gameplay]
[*] [b]Chapters visuals[/b] in Menu
[*] [b]Settings[/b] - Volume, 60 FPS Block, Reset Data, Reset Achievements.
[*] Catalyst SFX.
[*] New ToGame Catalyst
[/list]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]"My Child" achievement is back![/b]
[*] Project launches with Unlimited FPS Cap.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed sensitivity in a scene [Slightly].
[*][b] [Turns out I have been misspelling "prepArations" in my builds for the past 3 weeks, haven't noticed, heh-][/b]
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The title now has a dot after "Mr" [Simply just a formal grammatical design change].
[*] Changed to a better-looking output animation in Catalyst [Loading Screen].
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] When selecting Localization sequence, it now automatically selects a button for the currently active language.
[*] Eyes Coloring is now less repeatable.
[*] Menu Sprite's eyes now close during an attempt to close the game.
[*] Exit now doesn't activate "after the blink effects" just before the exit itself.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Polish Localization blockage for the intro is no more. [... I think]
[/list]

[h1]Additions:[/h1] [list] [*] The [b]Launch Disclaimer Warning [/b]with a localization choice along with the first save launch. [*] The synchronised [b]blinking gimmick[/b] for Menu. [*] [b]The Title[/b]. [*] All of the Menu options now have their sequences + animations. [Under Construction] [*] The variety of Catalyst [Loading screen] animations. [*] The new OST layer for Menu. [/list] [h1]Changes:[/h1] [list] [*] [b]The sprite for Menu[/b] got changed. [*] Changed Menu start requirement. [*] Catalyst between scenes is now not a scene itself but a Universal Object, and with that, its behaviour has changed. [A lot has changed] [*] Catalyst IS NOW ACTUALLY a [b]loading screen[/b]. [*] Changed the thickness of Texts. [/list] [h1]Fixes:[/h1] [list] [*] Text Reader is now more proficient. [*] Text Eraser in intro doesn't show "
" anymore. [*] Save File structure simplified. [*] Scene Requirements for scene memory simplified. [/list] [h3]And who knows what else, can't recall-[/h3]

[h3][b]Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] +2 Intro Monologues.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 16:10 Compatibility.
[*] The Localization menu is now more suitable.
[*] Menu buttons' state animations sweetened.
[/list]
[h3][b]System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [With the first launch] Enhanced detection for lack of Save Data.
[*] [With the first launch] Steam API detection isn't leaky anymore.
[*] [With the first launch] Build Version string updates.
[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Slight environmental changes. [Just lifted the ceiling a bit-]
[/list]

- Localization Structure Upgrade [Dynamic, now doesn't require a scene restart].
 
- "Steam Launch" Achievement is no more.
- "My Child Achievement" is now unachievable; it's mine and mine only! [Except for Peter, he can have it, he's cool]
